title: Roswell technologies per Corso were German 1940s inventions
place_text: Roswell, New Mexico; Germany; North Africa

tellings.quote: But uh Farrell researched this and he provides documentation that shows that the Germans had invented every single one of these in the 1940s.

related.note: Both are about the technologies Corso said came from Roswell. This telling claims the Germans had already invented them in the 1940s, which contradicts the reverse-engineered-from-the-crash account.

plain: The technologies that the Army officer Philip J. Corso said came from the craft that crashed at Roswell, New Mexico, as told in his book The Day After Roswell, were all invented by the Germans in the 1940s. A researcher named Jason Jorjani says so, citing a writer named Joseph P. Farrell, whose work Saucer Swastikas and SCOPS, Jorjani says, "provides documentation" for every one. If true, it would mean that technology credited to a crashed alien craft had a human, German origin.
